messages:
zara: PR #2705 ready for review: Migration guide 'Private network patterns' + new SDK snippet variants. Preview: https://preview.redwood-inference.com/pr-2705. Assigned @kai for tech, @paul for style. Docs CI shows linkcheck + vale flags on the preview so hold merge.

ci-bot: CI summary for PR #2705 — failing checks: linkcheck, vale. Re-run with /retest.

zara: Pasting the failing output to triage quickly:
```
LINKCHECK FAIL: /docs/private/networking.md -> broken link: https://partners.redwood-inference.com/old-networking-guide (404)
VALE FAIL: docs/private/networking.md:102 — VALE[Consistency] hyphenation mismatch: 'cache friendly' vs 'cache-friendly' (style: prefer hyphenated compound modifiers)
SPELLCHECK NOTE: 'onprem' -> consider 'on-prem'
```

kai: I'll take the partner link — they reorganized their site. Safer to replace with our KB canonical path and include a minimal inline snippet to avoid external dependency.

paul: I'll fix the Vale hyphenation and scan for other compound modifiers. Also will remove 'we' phrasing and correct tone. Won't modify code samples besides formatting.

zara: Quick question: these SDK snippets are used in a downstream integration that pins exact samples. Can we keep the snippet semantics identical (no whitespace or quoting changes) to avoid breaking their pin?

ops-bot: Note: downstream repo 'infra-integrations' tracks snippet pins. If formatting changes are necessary, please add an entry in the PR body with the exact diff lines for their maintainer.

kai: Pushed small commit replacing external link with KB link + inline networking callout (commit 7c9d02). Preview rebuild queued.\

docs-bot: Pull request updated — new commit 7c9d02 by kai. Docs preview: https://preview.redwood-inference.com/pr-2705 (build queued).

ci-bot: Docs preview completed — linkcheck PASS, vale FAIL (1 rule).

paul: The Vale hit is a single consistency rule. I'll change 'cache friendly' -> 'cache-friendly' and search/replace similar occurrences. Pushing now (tiny docs-only change, preserving code fences exactly).\

docs-bot: Pull request updated — new commit e1f4a7 by paul. Preview rebuild started: https://preview.redwood-inference.com/pr-2705

ci-bot: Docs preview passed — all checks green.

zara: All green. Planning to merge at 16:00 PT in today's docs merge window unless objections. Will include KB cross-ref and the downstream snippet note in PR description.

kai: Tech LGTM. No functional changes.

paul: Style LGTM. Kept snippets untouched functionally.

zara: Merging at 16:00 PT (squash) if no objections. Thanks for the quick fixes. :thumbsup:
